targets.query:
import "array"
import "dict"
import "strings"

// Alias opcionales, definidos en la variable oculta "aliases" del
// dashboard. El par vacío del final evita una lista vacía, que
// dict.fromList no acepta.
aliasPairs = array.filter(arr: strings.split(v: "${aliases}" + ",=", t: ","), fn: (x) => strings.containsStr(v: x, substr: "="))
aliases = dict.fromList(pairs: array.map(arr: aliasPairs, fn: (x) => {
    parts = strings.split(v: x, t: "=")
    return {key: strings.trimSpace(v: parts[0]), value: strings.trimSpace(v: parts[1])}
}))

latest = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_telemetry" and contains(value: r.device_id, set: ${device_id:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature_c" or r._field == "humidity_pct" or r._field == "sequence" or r._field == "uptime_ms" or r._field == "rssi_dbm")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))

// Antigüedad del último mensaje de cada nodo, en segundos.
age = latest
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "sequence")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "age_s", _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))

union(tables: [latest, age])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with device: dict.get(dict: aliases, key: r.device_id, default: r.device_id)}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["device"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["device", "temperature_c", "humidity_pct", "age_s", "rssi_dbm", "sequence", "uptime_ms"])
